subject: Follow-up: pricing & model mix — post-demo recap
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@finovateanalytics.com>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@acmeinsights.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Follow-up: pricing & model mix — post-demo recap

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and a few qualification items so we can get you a targeted pricing proposition: 

Call notes (short):
- Primary use: real-time chat assistant embedded in product (in-session semantic search + context-aware summarization).
- Secondary: nightly batch embeddings for similarity index refresh; small reranking pipeline for results sorting.
- Latency SLOs: p95 < 300ms for chat; embeddings ok with minutes latency.
- Data residency: US-only.

Open asks for pricing and unit-econ qualification (please confirm):
1) Expected monthly tokens by model type (approx):
   - Chat / generation: ? tokens/month
   - Embeddings: ? tokens/month (or number of vectors/month + avg size)
   - Rerank: ? tokens/month or queries/month
2) Target budget range for hosted inference (monthly) — ballpark is fine (e.g., $Xk–$Yk).
3) Target $ / 1M tokens or top-level cost target that would make this purchase straightforward for you.
4) Any constraints on contract length / PO timing this quarter?

Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (internal call notes) and a first-pass token-pricing-v1.xlsx that maps a few model mixes to cost ranges.

Proposed next steps:
- You send approximate volumes & priority model mix (chat vs embeddings vs rerank).
- We run 2 pricing scenarios: conservative (safe SLO with modest batching) and optimized (aggressive batching/quantization + caching) and return a short mutual action plan and recommended tier.

Would appreciate the volume mix by EOD Thursday if possible so we can get the draft pricing in front of your procurement team early next week.

Best,
Rishi
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & model mix — post-demo recap

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the clear recap. Apologies for the short reply — Tom and I pulled some numbers together after the call. Below are rough monthly forecasts for month 1 → month 6 steady state (ballpark):

- Chat / generation (high interactivity): 350M tokens/month (text in + completions combined). Expect this to grow 10–15% month-over-month.
- Embeddings (indexing & batch refresh): 8M tokens/month producing ~400k vectors (avg 20 tokens/embedding).
- Rerank (post-retrieval dedupe/sorting): ~120M tokens/month (mostly short passages used for pairwise scoring).

Budget guidance: we are targeting an annual contract but procurement wants a monthly hosted cost under $25k to start (ideally $15k–$20k / month at PoC scale). If we can get to $10–12k / month for an optimized tier that would be a stretch goal.

Unit-econ ask: Our CFO wants to see a target $/1M tokens for chat in the $40–$55 range (that maps into their internal model). If you can provide a tiered $/1M for chat + separate for embeddings + rerank, that will help.

Contract timing: We are budgeting for Q2 procurement review. PO likely in 4–6 weeks after pricing.

Let me know if you need any further breakdowns (e.g., how much of chat is prompts vs completions or average prompt length).

Cheers,
Elena
Head of Product — Finovate Analytics
elena.soto@finovateanalytics.com

Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & model mix — post-demo recap

Hi Elena —

Great to see the volume breakdown — that's exactly what we needed. A few quick clarifying questions so our cost model matches your usage: 
1) For chat: is the 350M tokens/month including system + user prompts and the assistant outputs? Do you have an average turn length (user prompt ~40 tokens, assistant ~120 tokens is a useful starting assumption).
2) For rerank: are the 120M tokens mostly short snippets (average 30–40 tokens each)? Are these synchronous calls that need p95 < 200ms?
3) Embeddings: are all 400k vectors produced overnight, or do you have a steady stream during the day (affects batching opportunities).

Preliminary unit-econ (very rough):
- Conservative (hosted, default batching): Chat ~ $48 / 1M tokens, Embeddings ~ $35 / 1M tokens (vector generation cost normalized), Rerank ~ $28 / 1M tokens.
- Optimized (aggressive batching + prefix cache + quantization guidance): Chat ~ $32 / 1M tokens, Embeddings ~ $20 / 1M tokens, Rerank ~ $18 / 1M tokens.

Notes:
- The optimized scenario assumes we can apply prefix/KV caching for typical session patterns and use our recommended quantized model variant for rerank and embeddings. It also assumes a 30–40% effective batching improvement on chat token cost and 2–3x cost reduction on embeddings vs conservative.
- For your procurement target of $15k–$25k / month, the optimized pricing with the proposed mix lands around $18k/month at 350M chat + 120M rerank + 8M embeddings (we'll share a line-item spreadsheet). If you need to be under $12k, we'd discuss a blended committed tier with a 12–24 month commitment and reserved capacity (Dedicated) which drops unit costs further.

Next steps:
- If you confirm the clarifying items above, we'll produce a one-page mutual action plan and an updated token-pricing workbook (will attach token-pricing-v1.xlsx updated).
- I'll also run a short benchmark (same model variants we demoed) against a 10k-sample of your typical chat transcripts if you can share a small anonymized dump — that will let us firm up per-1M estimates.

Best,
Monica Patel
Solutions — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
